sn47.26:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahā-Moggalāno āyasmā ca Anuruddho Sākete viharanti Kanṭakīvane || || 2.
sn47.26:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca MahāMoggalāno sāyaṇhasamayam patisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsa || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Anuruddhena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu ||
sn47.26:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ Kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantam Anuruddham etad avoca || || 3.
sn47.26:1.4: Sekho sekho ti āvuso Anuruddha vuccati ||
sn47.26:1.5: kittāvatā nu kho āvuso Sekho ti hotī ti || ||
sn47.26:1.6: Catunnam kho āvuso satipaṭṭhānānam padesaṃ bhāvitattā sekho hoti ||
sn47.26:2.2: Idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyyyaloke abhijjhadomanassaṃ ||
sn47.26:2.5: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn47.26:2.6: Imesaṃ kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānam padesam bhāvitattā sekho hotī ti || || (3).27. (7) Samattam. 1--2.
